# Common Dreams

> Common Dreams is a progressive news and opinion platform covering politics, climate crisis, economic justice, civil rights, and international conflicts with a focus on grassroots activism and social change.

Common Dreams publishes breaking news and in-depth analysis on Trump administration policies, climate change, military spending, healthcare, and Middle East conflicts. The site features reporting from journalists like Brett Wilkins and opinion columns alongside coverage of progressive figures like Bernie Sanders.

## Key Topics

- Trump administration
- Iran conflict
- Middle East
- Climate change
- Military spending
- Defense budget
- Healthcare policy
- Fossil fuels
- Bernie Sanders
- Civil rights
- Press freedom
- US foreign policy
- Extreme heat
- Pentagon budget
- Political news

## Breaking News & Headlines

- [Common Dreams | Latest News](https://www.commondreams.org/news): Main news hub featuring breaking news on Trump, Iran, Middle East conflicts, and urgent political developments

## Core News Sections

- [Politics](https://www.commondreams.org/politics): Political news covering Bernie Sanders, Trump administration, defense spending, and congressional action
- [War & Peace](https://www.commondreams.org/war-peace): International conflict coverage including Iran tensions, Middle East crises, and US foreign policy analysis
- [Climate](https://www.commondreams.org/climate): Climate crisis news with coverage of extreme heat, western heatwaves, and fossil fuel policy
- [Economy](https://www.commondreams.org/economy): Economic news covering tech policy, AI regulation, Big Tech criticism, and healthcare policy
- [Rights & Justice](https://www.commondreams.org/rights-justice): Civil rights and justice coverage including press freedom, First Amendment protections, and court rulings

## Opinion & Analysis

- [Opinion](https://www.commondreams.org/opinion): Progressive opinion and editorial content analyzing policy, foreign relations, and social issues
- [Further](https://www.commondreams.org/further): Opinion column by Abby Zimet featuring political satire, commentary, and progressive analysis
